cards.name: Bring into Focus
cards.summary: Puts the selected object or group into Focus mode: it is brought temporarily to the front, a transparent overlay (opacity adjustable) covers every other object so they cannot be selected or edited, and a floating breadcrumb toolbar shows its place in the design hierarchy, so you can work inside groups, nested groups, PowerClips, symmetry groups or bitmaps. The harvest shows it enabled with a rectangle or a bitmap selected; Exit Focus Mode (Shift+Esc) leaves the mode and keeps the edits.
use_for: editing objects inside a nested group without ungrouping it
adjusting PowerClip contents in a crowded poster or brochure page
working on one element of a dense layout without nudging the others
avoid: a one-off tweak to a single group member: Ctrl+click it with the Pick tool to select it inside the group without entering Focus mode
several ungrouped objects, tables or connector lines: they cannot be brought into focus; group the objects first
drawing new artwork that belongs elsewhere: objects created in Focus mode are grouped with the focused object, so exit first
scripted runs that then select or export other objects: run Exit Focus Mode first, or everything else stays locked under the overlay

review.changes: summary said the rest of the drawing is hidden; installed Help (Edit objects in Focus mode) says a transparent overlay of adjustable opacity covers it. Rewrote summary from Help, added the unsupported-object and new-objects-join-the-focus-group gotchas, fixed the scripted-run avoid, confidence medium->high

cards.name: Clone
cards.summary: Makes a clone of the selected object: a linked copy whose fill, outline, shape and other attributes follow the master, so editing the master updates every clone; an attribute changed on a clone stops following the master until you use Revert to Master. The harvest shows the command enabled with a document open even with nothing selected, but it works on the selection.
use_for: a badge or logo repeated across a layout that must change in one place
a row of identical icons whose colour is recoloured once on the master
design variants where a few clones override the fill but keep the master's shape
avoid: an independent copy you will edit freely: use Duplicate (Ctrl+D)
artwork reused many times or across documents: use a symbol (Object > Symbol > Create New Symbol), which also keeps the file small
files sent to other apps: clone links do not survive export, so expect plain copies
cloning a clone: CorelDRAW does not allow it, clone the master object instead

review.changes: added the documented 'a clone cannot be cloned' limit and the Revert to Master undo for overrides (installed Help, Clone objects); confidence medium->high

cards.name: Copy
cards.summary: Copies the selected objects to the Windows clipboard and leaves the originals in place, ready for Paste, Paste in View or Paste Special here or in another application.
use_for: moving artwork between pages or documents
bringing vector art into another app such as Office or a layout program
keeping a copy on the clipboard before a destructive edit
avoid: just making another copy on the same page: Duplicate (Ctrl+D) skips the clipboard
handing vectors to Photoshop or Illustrator where fidelity matters: export SVG, PDF or AI instead of relying on the clipboard format

cards.name: Copy Properties From
cards.summary: Transfers outline pen, outline colour, fill and/or text attributes from another object onto the selected object(s): a dialog asks which properties to take, then the cursor turns into an arrow and you click the source object. Size, shape and position of the selection stay as they are. Needs a second object to pick, which is why the harvest enables it only when something is selected and the drawing holds more than one object.
cards.how: Select the object(s) to restyle, choose Edit > Copy Properties From, tick Outline pen, Outline color, Fill and / or Text properties, click OK, then click the object that already has the look you want. Only the ticked properties are copied.
use_for: matching fill and outline across the shapes of an icon set
giving several text objects a headline's font settings
quickly syncing colour styling between elements of a layout
avoid: a look that will be reused and changed later: define it in the Object Styles docker so edits propagate
copying effects such as shadow, contour, envelope or blend: use the Object > Copy Effect submenu
picking attributes interactively in a single click: the Attributes Eyedropper tool does the same job
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("f16b149b-969f-415c-8863-e42fb5393b6b") only opens the dialog. Object model: ActiveSelectionRange.CopyPropertiesFrom(SourceShape, cdrCopyFill + cdrCopyOutlinePen + cdrCopyOutlineColor + cdrCopyTextAttrs) (unverified)

cards.name: Cut
cards.summary: Removes the selected objects from the page and puts them on the Windows clipboard, so they can be pasted elsewhere in the document or into another application.
use_for: moving objects to another page, layer or document
pulling an element out of a layout to paste it inside text or another app
avoid: simply removing objects: Delete leaves the clipboard untouched
moving objects between layers in the same document: drag them in the Objects docker instead of cutting and pasting

cards.name: Delete
cards.summary: Removes the selected objects from the drawing without putting them on the clipboard; Undo brings them back.
use_for: clearing stray or hidden objects before export
removing construction shapes after a weld, trim or intersect
cleaning up a template before reuse
avoid: objects you may need again later in a scripted run: hide them or move them to a hidden layer instead
moving objects elsewhere: use Cut so they land on the clipboard

cards.name: Duplicate
cards.summary: Makes a copy of the selected objects directly in the drawing, without the clipboard, placed by the document's duplicate offset; the copy becomes the new selection. In the harvest's live audit, duplicating two selected shapes raised the shape count from 13 to 15 with the copies at the same X positions as the originals.
use_for: making a variant of a shape to recolour or resize
building repeated layout elements one at a time
keeping an untouched backup copy before a destructive edit
avoid: many evenly spaced copies: use Step and Repeat (Ctrl+Shift+D)
copies that must stay in sync with the original: use Clone or a symbol

cards.name: Exit Focus Mode
cards.summary: Leaves Focus mode (entered with Bring into Focus): the overlay over the other objects is removed so the whole drawing is selectable again, and the edits made in focus are kept, with the object's name and place in the hierarchy restored in the Objects docker. It is enabled only while Focus mode is active, which is why the harvest found it disabled in all four test states (no document, document, rectangle selected, bitmap selected).
use_for: returning to the full layout after editing a group or PowerClip in isolation
closing a scripted Focus-mode edit before selecting or exporting other objects
avoid: calling it when Focus mode is not active: it is disabled and does nothing

review.changes: summary said exiting 'shows the whole drawing again' (it was never hidden, only overlaid); rewrote from installed Help: overlay removed, edits kept, name and hierarchy restored in Objects docker; confidence medium->high

cards.name: Find and Replace
cards.summary: Opens or closes the Find and Replace docker (a toggle; the same docker is under Window > Dockers), which finds objects by object type, fill, outline, special effect, name or style, finds words, and replaces colours, colour models, outline and text properties or text. By default it searches only the current page; the range can be widened to all or chosen pages or narrowed to the selection.
cards.how: Choose Find Objects, Replace Objects or Find and Replace Text from the list at the top of the docker, set the criteria (Add Query for object types, fills, outlines and special effects; a Find and a Replace colour; or the words with Match case), then use Find Next / Find Previous, Find All or Find All on Page to select the matches, or Replace / Replace All.
use_for: swapping one brand colour for another across a whole document
finding every use of a font before sending files to print
correcting a repeated word or price in a menu, catalogue or flyer
avoid: a single text fix: edit it directly with the Text tool
scripted bulk changes: query shapes with the object model instead of driving the docker
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("58fc6ba1-0311-23a8-4100-9c6bcea1ce61") only toggles the docker. Object model: ActiveDocument.ActivePage.Shapes.FindShapes(Name, Type, Recursive, Query), e.g. FindShapes(Type:=cdrTextShape), or a CQL string in Query; Shape.Text.Find(Text, CaseSensitive) for words (unverified)

review.changes: script_api had an invented CQL literal ('CMYK(0,100,100,0)'); replaced with a harvested FindShapes signature + cdrTextShape and IVGText.Find(Text, CaseSensitive). Summary/how rewritten from installed Help (modes Find Objects / Replace Objects / Find and Replace Text; default range is the current page); confidence medium->high

cards.name: Paste
cards.summary: Pastes the clipboard into the active layer. Objects copied inside CorelDRAW land at the coordinates they were copied from, images and vector data from other applications come in as CorelDRAW objects, and pasted text first opens the Importing/Pasting Text dialog (keep fonts and formatting, formatting only, or discard both); with the Text tool in a text object the clipboard goes in at the cursor.
use_for: copying artwork into the same spot on another page
bringing images or text from other applications into a layout
inserting copied text into a paragraph
avoid: pasting where you are currently looking: use Paste in View (Ctrl+Shift+V)
choosing the clipboard format (unformatted text, metafile, OLE object): use Paste Special

review.changes: summary said text from other apps simply comes in as objects; installed Help (Import and paste text) says pasted text first opens the Importing/Pasting Text dialog. Added that

cards.name: Paste in View
cards.summary: Pastes the clipboard into the area of the drawing window you are currently viewing, instead of at the objects' original coordinates, so pasted objects appear where you are working. Precise placement (centre of the view) was not checked in the harvest.
use_for: pasting copied elements onto a page or area you have scrolled or zoomed to
bringing artwork from another document into view on a large canvas
avoid: keeping the original position (for example, the same spot on another page): use Paste (Ctrl+V)

cards.name: Paste Special
cards.summary: Opens the Paste Special dialog, which lists the formats the clipboard holds and pastes in the one you pick (for example the source application's object, a picture/metafile, a bitmap, rich text or plain text), optionally as a linked OLE object that stays connected to the source file.
cards.how: Copy something in another application, choose Edit > Paste Special, pick the format in the As list and choose Paste (embed a copy) or Paste Link (keep a live OLE link to the source file), then click OK.
use_for: pasting text without its formatting so it takes the document's text style
embedding a spreadsheet or chart as an OLE object that can be edited in its source app
choosing between bitmap and vector versions of copied content
avoid: ordinary pasting: Paste (Ctrl+V) is faster
print or PDF jobs: OLE objects and links can render differently; paste as picture or import the file instead
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("b52abcd3-3b31-4123-9715-083f9b72c8c5") only opens the dialog. Object model: ActiveLayer.PasteSpecial(FormatName, PasteLink) (unverified)

cards.name: Redo %s
cards.summary: Re-applies the action that was last undone; the menu caption replaces %s with that action's name (for example Redo Move). It is disabled until something has been undone, as in every harvested state.
use_for: stepping forward again after undoing too far
comparing a design before and after an edit with Undo / Redo
avoid: after a new edit following an undo: the redo history is discarded

cards.name: Repeat %s
cards.summary: Repeats the last command on the current selection; the menu caption replaces %s with that command (for example Repeat Move or Repeat Rotate), so a move, rotation, fill change or duplicate can be applied again to the same or another object.
use_for: stepping a duplicated object across the page at the same offset
rotating copies by the same angle to build a radial pattern
applying the same fill or outline change to another object
avoid: an exact number of evenly spaced copies: use Step and Repeat
repeating anything but the most recent command: only the last one is remembered

cards.name: Guidelines
cards.summary: Selects all guidelines on the current page, both the page's own (local) guidelines and the master guidelines, so they can be moved, recoloured, locked or deleted together.
use_for: deleting every guide before handing off or exporting a file
shifting a whole guide grid to a new margin
recolouring or locking all layout guides at once
avoid: selecting artwork: guidelines are selected on their own, use Select All > Objects for objects
clearing guides from one page only: master guidelines are selected too, and deleting them removes them from every page

review.changes: replaced the 'not checked' caveat with installed Help (Modify guidelines): selects the page's local guidelines and the master guidelines; added the master-guide delete gotcha; confidence medium->high

cards.name: Nodes
cards.summary: Selects every node of the selected curve object, so node commands on the Shape tool's property bar (convert to curve or line, smooth, cusp, reduce nodes) act on the whole path at once. It needs a curve: the harvest found it disabled with a rectangle or a bitmap selected.
use_for: smoothing or reducing all nodes of a traced logo outline
turning every segment of a path into curves before reshaping
moving or scaling a whole path's nodes with the Shape tool
avoid: rectangles, ellipses, polygons and text: convert them to curves first (Object > Convert to Curves, Ctrl+Q)
selecting whole objects: use Select All > Objects

cards.name: Objects
cards.summary: Selects all objects on the active page at once, ready for moving, aligning, grouping or exporting as a set.
use_for: grouping a finished layout before scaling it
aligning or centring everything on the page
exporting or copying a whole page's artwork
avoid: selecting only text: use Select All > Text
selecting by colour or other properties: use Find and Replace

review.changes: removed the unsupported claim that locked objects (and locked/hidden-layer objects) are left out; installed Help shows locked objects are selectable (Lock objects: select a locked object to unlock it)

cards.name: Text
cards.summary: Selects all the text objects (artistic and paragraph text) on the current page and nothing else.
use_for: converting all text to curves before sending a file to print
changing the font, size or colour of every text object at once
checking which elements of a layout are live text
avoid: text inside groups or PowerClips that must also be caught: check the result in the Objects docker
selecting all objects: use Select All > Objects

cards.name: Step and Repeat
cards.summary: Opens or closes the Step and Repeat docker (it is a toggle; the same docker is under Window > Dockers), which makes a set number of copies of the selection at a horizontal and/or vertical offset, either a fixed distance between copies or a spacing between objects, in a chosen direction.
cards.how: Select the object, open the docker (Ctrl+Shift+D), enter the Number of copies, then for Horizontal and Vertical choose the mode (no offset, offset, or spacing between objects), the distance and the direction, and click Apply.
use_for: a sheet of business cards, labels or tickets for print
evenly spaced rows of icons, dots or bullets
calendar and table grids built from one cell
avoid: copies around a centre or along a curve: use the Transform docker (Alt+F7) with copies, or a blend along a path
copies that must stay identical after later edits: use clones or symbols
cards.script_api: FrameWork.Automation.InvokeItem("39692b96-54c8-4f1a-b189-8147321948b6") only toggles the docker. Object model: ActiveSelectionRange.StepAndRepeat(NumCopies, DistanceX, DistanceY, ModeX, DirectionX, ModeY, DirectionY) (unverified)

cards.name: Undo %s
cards.summary: Reverses the last action; the menu caption replaces %s with that action's name (for example Undo Delete). Repeating it steps further back through the undo history.
use_for: backing out of a mistaken edit
comparing a design before and after a change with Undo / Redo
avoid: jumping back many steps: the History docker (Window > Dockers > History) lists the whole undo history
scripts that must roll back their own changes: wrap them in ActiveDocument.BeginCommandGroup / EndCommandGroup so one undo removes them
